text_block_list.text: One day, while training Mejiro Ardan as usual—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. We are nearing the end of today's menu, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Little by little, I can feel my foundational stamina building up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—However, what truly changed
might just be her mindset.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My previous training was, in a way,
like a desperate "struggle"
to fight against fate, I think.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Right now, with the mindset of solidifying my ground,
I feel like I am steadily moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now then, shall we run just a little bit more?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Without haste, with sincerity, and with steady progress.
—Well then.
